name: 到期管家
description: Track recurring due dates and Apple Reminders with compact widgets, safe completion history, local backups, optional notifications, and checked updates.

localizedDescriptions.en: 2.6.0 adds system / brand-priority icons for the small widget, per-item selection across 332 brand names and 2 bundled official logos (SafePal and Telegram). Missing artwork falls back to system symbols. Tapping the main icon still completes the exact item; existing settings default to system icons.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 2.6.0 新增小号组件「系统图标／品牌 Logo 优先」及逐项选择。332 个品牌名称选项，首批内置 SafePal、Telegram 两套官方素材；其余或缺图时回退系统图标。点击主图标仍完成事项，旧数据默认保留系统样式。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 2.6.0 新增小号组件「系统图标／品牌 Logo 优先」及逐项选择。332 个品牌名称选项，首批内置 SafePal、Telegram 两套官方素材；其余或缺图时回退系统图标。点击主图标仍完成事项，旧数据默认保留系统样式。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 2.6.0 新增小號元件「系統圖示／品牌 Logo 優先」及逐項選擇。332 個品牌名稱選項，首批內置 SafePal、Telegram 兩套官方素材；其餘或缺圖時回退系統圖示。點按主圖示仍完成事項，舊資料預設保留系統樣式。
